item_short_desc: Designed to clean and help dry your hydration bladder – Rothco’s Bladder Cleaning Kit is equipped with a drying hanger and 3 brushes to extend the life of the bladder.
description: Designed to clean and help dry your hydration bladder – Rothco’s bladder cleaning kit is equipped with a drying hanger and 3 brushes to extend the life of the bladder. The flexible 37.5” long snake brush thoroughly cleans your entire bladder hose. The cleaning system includes a large (15.5”) and small (5.25”) brush for detailed cleaning of the hydration bladder and mouth piece to prevent bacterial build-up.  After cleaning, use the collapsible frame / drying rack for proper airflow for the bladder to effectively dry (12.75” x 5/8”). Includes small plastic clips (2) hold cleaning components together when not in use.
